Key Architectural Properties:
• Single Responsibility Filters: Each filter performs one stateless transformation without knowledge of adjacent filters.
• Decoupling Pipes: Message queues serve as point-to-point pipes, allowing filters to execute at independent processing rates.
• Recomposability: Filters can be added, reordered, or branched dynamically without modifying existing components.
